scientific_integrity: Analytic derivations and independently generated matrix-semigroup/symbolic comparison provided. The source paper already implies the tuned one-time stationary-law identity; originality is claimed only for the all-lag two-time covariance distinction and its integrated consequence, not the standalone spatial coincidence.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional, symmetric ballistic directions; strictly positive rates, Brownian diffusivity and propulsion speed; complete Poisson resetting of both position and state. Equal position distributions do not imply equal processes or full-state distributions. Finite-parameter numerical checks are not proofs; independent priority review remains outstanding.
title: Exact spatial aliasing and strict temporal separation in intermittent resetting transport
